items.source:
This package contains the core infrastructure for creating an
imperative or reactive client that can execute queries.
items.translation: 该包提供了创建可执行查询的指令式或响应式客户端的核心基础设施。

items.source: A set of annotations for providing custom queries to repositories.
items.translation: 用于向仓库提供自定义查询的一组注解。

items.source: A default predicate that does not filter anything.
items.translation: 一个不筛选任何内容的默认谓词。

items.source: Checks if the mapping contains possible circles.
items.translation: 检查映射中是否存在可能的环路。

items.source: Creates a return statement for an ongoing match.
items.translation: 为进行中的比赛创建返回语句。

items.source: This returns the relationships this node, its parent and child has to other nodes.
items.translation: 此方法返回该节点、其父节点和子节点与其他节点之间的关系。
